title: Xhosa Tales (Theal, 1882)
originalTitle: Kaffir Folk-lore: A Selection from the Traditional Tales Current among the People Living on the Eastern Border of the Cape Colony

translation.name: Xhosa Tales (Theal, 1882) — George McCall Theal (collector and translator) (1882)

editorialMarkers: Xhosa oral narratives collected from named and unnamed narrators on the Cape eastern frontier and translated into English by a colonial historian; the Xhosa originals are not printed, and Theal’s framing is his own. The book’s original title uses a term that is now a slur in South Africa; Wellspring displays the work as “Xhosa Tales (Theal, 1882)” and records the original title in the edition and citation fields. OCR from a scan; opening ornamental initials may be missing. Each story is a chapter; multi-part stories keep their parts together.
citation: Theal, G. M. Kaffir Folk-lore: A Selection from the Traditional Tales Current among the People Living on the Eastern Border of the Cape Colony (London, 1882). Public domain; Internet Archive scan (Cornell).

provenance.method: OCR text of the scan, conservatively cleaned (hyphenation, running headers, page numbers); no words supplied
